subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should this protected workflow dependency update merge after owner-reviewed evidence from the token, Codex-agent, Docker, and security workflow paths, or should it wait for a narrower validated update?
rationale: These updates alter third-party code executed with repository tokens, publishing credentials, and security-scanning permissions; maintainer acceptance is needed because ordinary static diff review cannot establish the repository-specific privileged workflow behavior.

options.title: Validate privileged workflow paths
options.body: Run or inspect redacted successful executions of the affected token, Codex-agent, Docker, and security workflows at this exact head, then merge if the owners accept the action contracts.

options.title: Split the update
options.body: Land only independently verified low-risk action pins and defer the privileged token, publishing, security, and Codex-agent pins to a separately evidenced PR.

options.title: Pause this batch
options.body: Close or defer the batch if the workflow owners do not want to validate the broad privileged-action update together.

recommendation.title: Validate privileged workflow paths
recommendation.body: Run or inspect redacted successful executions of the affected token, Codex-agent, Docker, and security workflows at this exact head, then merge if the owners accept the action contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: No responsible workflow owner could be established without the required local history and CODEOWNERS inspection.
